title: Windows Administrator Logon
description: Alert-ready search for successful logons by the built-in Administrator account. Extend the approved-account filter for renamed or localized administrator accounts.
query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4624' and ('Target User Name' = 'Administrator' or User = 'Administrator') | stats count as AdministratorLogons by 'Target User Name', 'Logon Type', 'Host Name (Server)' | sort -AdministratorLogons
